time_to_core.description: Scott-Knott ESD ranking by months to core achievement
time_to_core.rationale: Parallels EASE 2026 Figure 5: ranking temporal patterns by time-to-core effectiveness
time_to_core.note: Rank 1 = fastest. Same rank = no significant difference with at least small effect size.

core_rate_by_event_type.description: Scott-Knott ESD ranking of event types + organic by core rate
core_rate_by_event_type.rationale: Identifies which entry pathways are statistically distinct in core achievement
core_rate_by_event_type.note: Rank 1 = lowest core rate. Higher rank = higher rate.

core_rate_3groups.description: Scott-Knott ESD ranking of 3 groups by core rate
core_rate_3groups.rationale: Parallels ICSE 2026 Figure 2: ranking groups by outcome variable
core_rate_3groups.key_finding: All 3 groups receive the same rank because pairwise Cliff's delta values are below the small-effect threshold (0.147), indicating the differences, while statistically significant due to large N, are not practically meaningful.

time_to_core_stratified.description: Scott-Knott ESD ranking by group x project type on time-to-core
